reconciliations.dictionary_hierarchy: Native child_values include code, description and is_active but may omit parent audit metadata. Validate every nested label and active flag while preserving all parent schema requirements.
reconciliations.device_dispense_example_enums: Inline DeviceDispense detail enums freeze example quantities, prices, labels and identifiers. The same snapshot named Device_Dispense_Detail_Response documents these fields as variable number/string values. Only these literal-example restrictions are replaced; types, required fields, reference type and system stay strict.
reconciliations.device_request_quantityless_type: TV39 3.20.2.2.3.2 and 3.20.3.1.5 allow a type code without program or quantities. The alternative excludes program, code_reference, quantity and remaining_quantity.
reconciliations.allOf_sibling_properties: Provider allOf closures are normalized with only documented sibling names. Actual field schemas remain in their declaring parts; generic allOf remains strict.
reconciliations.encounter_participant: Both native Medical Events examples use employee participants, while the enum only declares care_team. The endpoint-specific enum retains both documented representations.
reconciliations.medical_program_settings: Both General MIS snapshots declare object items but their examples use CLASSIFICATION_TYPE/DEVICE_DEFINITION strings. Examples also declare top-level medication request/dispense permission and text fields. Only these documented alternatives are retained.
reconciliations.episode_ongoing_state: The native Episode_Of_Care_Response component and GET examples omit care_team/part_of. Create Episode does not submit status_reason/history; Close/Cancel requires a reason. Only ongoing active snapshots without end/closing/explanation may omit reason/history; present fields retain their full native schema.
